subject.title: Dashboard: action-form widget — buttons and forms that dispatch the agent

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor a first-party dashboard action-form builtin that can dispatch parameterized prompts, and should it wait for the modular-dashboard substrate and security contract to land first?
rationale: This is a new dashboard-to-agent dispatch surface, not a broken existing contract, and automation cannot decide whether it belongs in the bundled dashboard plugin, an external plugin/ClawHub path, or a later plugin SDK extension.

options.title: Defer behind dashboard substrate review
options.body: Keep this issue open and require the Wave 1 dashboard substrate plus prompt-dispatch security contract to be accepted before implementation starts.

options.title: Sponsor as bundled builtin
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly approve a first-party action-form widget and review it as security-sensitive dashboard/runtime work.

options.title: Move to plugin/ClawHub direction
options.body: If maintainers do not want prompt-dispatching dashboard widgets bundled in OpenClaw, steer the work toward an external plugin or SDK-extension discussion.

recommendation.title: Defer behind dashboard substrate review
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require the Wave 1 dashboard substrate plus prompt-dispatch security contract to be accepted before implementation starts.

likelyOwner.reason: The current main history ties the relevant plugin-tab and gateway method surfaces to this owner, and the decision is about whether that surface should grow into a bundled dashboard action layer.
